purpose: Development-set diagnostic of displayed top-five physical DEM scale
query_selection: Eight known high-resolution reference sites, recommended complete center, each at 200/500/1000 m
limitations: Known development sites and the displayed top five are not independent analog truth.
Meter mode explicitly minimizes meter RMSE; its RMSE change is a direct objective effect, not evidence of analog accuracy.
The two modes augment and order their shortlist differently; this audit does not isolate those two changes.
Mars CTX 20 m post spacing does not guarantee that terrain detail is resolved at 20 m.
Relief and shape alone do not establish material, process, environment, or mission suitability.
